nodes.name: triangular_condorcet_cycles

nodes.name: balanced_accuracy_score

nodes.name: GromovWassersteinMatcher
nodes.summary: Solves entropic/unbalanced fused Gromov-Wasserstein alignment between clique distances and prototype distances via Picard iterations with an inner generalized Sinkhorn solver.

nodes.name: TransductiveCliqueCalibrator
nodes.summary: Calibrates clique posteriors along a continuous clique-size homotopy, blending softmax, mean-field cavity repulsion, and unbalanced transport with size-dependent column relaxation.

nodes.name: ConfidenceHodgeRank
nodes.summary: Projects pairwise flow matrices onto a curl-free potential using margin-weighted graph Laplacians, reporting curl energy and inconsistency metrics.

nodes.name: softmax

tour.title: Start with the competition contract
tour.description: Read AGENTS.md for the 18 classes, balanced-accuracy metric and dual-T4/offline constraints, then src/config.py for the canonical class order every view must align to.

tour.title: Measure honestly: grouped CV and the metric
tour.description: Prompt-grouped splits prevent topic leakage; src/metrics.py implements balanced accuracy and src/eval_stats.py supplies the confidence/proof instruments used to accept or reject every idea.

tour.title: Build the stylometric evidence layer
tour.description: Case- and punctuation-preserving features expose lab and sibling fingerprints. sibling_features.py defines 93 routed features, while cross-tokenizer and reasoning modules probe tokenizer boundaries and reasoning traces.

tour.title: Add deep representation without topic leakage
tour.description: Qwen3/OLMo2 trunks are pooled at intermediate layers, LoRA adapters are merged for offline inference, and prompt-subspace deconfounding removes the shared prompt direction from the representation.

tour.title: Calibrate and transport the posteriors
tour.description: The calibrator fits per-class temperatures, then Sinkhorn or Gromov-Wasserstein transport rebalances a prompt cluster toward the expected class marginal; cavity centering removes leave-one-out prompt effects.

tour.title: Fuse views and keep sibling corrections coherent
tour.description: Log-opinion pooling fits simplex weights, the pairwise injector projects edge updates onto a potential so sibling corrections cannot double-count the base model, and the length gate smoothly controls typographic evidence.

tour.title: Assemble the offline submission
tour.description: submission_sota.py inlines the winning modules into one self-contained kernel: load data, build views, fit fold models, calibrate, fuse, validate the parquet schema. Patches document the delta to each leaderboard attempt.

tour.title: Close the loop with experiments
tour.description: Numbered experiments turn every architectural claim into a measured OOF delta. Start with the integration gate, then the OT placement study and the invalidation suite to see which operators actually ship.
